title: Mixed Event — Here on Our Dream Stage — Episode2 A Performance From Scratch

meta.Event Outline: The schools of Shibuya are holding the Shibuya City High Schools Joint Festival, a place for students to put on performances. Nene takes on the task of putting on a musical with students from other schools.

rows.Line: One week later
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This looks like the building where the meeting for Shibu Schools Fest is taking place...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm still nervous about the idea of working with complete strangers... But I need to try my best!)
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: P-Pardon me...

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line:
No way! Really?!
I'm also in brass band! What instrument do you play?

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't know there was a shop like that so close to my school!

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line: Haha. Your teacher sounds fun.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Wh-Whoa...
There's like fifty people here, and they've all formed their little groups already.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Let's see... Is there anyone I recognize?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yeah, I didn't really expect it...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I'm going to be working with everyone here, so I need to show some initiative...)

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line: Huh? We have another person.

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line: Hey, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They're looking at me...)
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
H-Hi... My name is Nene Kusanagi.
I'm a second-year at Kamiyama High School.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-Nice to meet you all...!

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line: Yeah, nice to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line: Come sit next to me. This seat's open.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, okay. Thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line: Hehe. We're all in the same year, so let's keep things informal. Let's do our best together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Thank goodness. They all seem really nice.)

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Chair
rows.Line: Everyone, can I have your attention?

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Chair
rows.Line: I know it's a little early, but I'd like to begin our first meeting since everyone seems to be here now.

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Chair
rows.Line: My name is Shiina, and I'm the student council president at Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy. My school has been asked to lead this year's event, which means I'll be serving as the chair. I look forward to working with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Chair
rows.Line: First, I'll be explaining what our work is going to involve...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I see...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This festival is basically divided into two parts. The stage performances and all the exhibits.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And the members of the planning committee each need to choose which to work on.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So, I'd like to help with the stage performances. Helping with them should give me some good experience...)

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Chair
rows.Line:
Alright, please make your choices now.
You'll all be talking with your groups once things have settled.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Okay, the group for stage performances is... Over here.)
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line: You're all here to help with the stage performances, yes? If so, let's start talking about what we'll be doing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line: First, this joint festival involves two different stages.

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line:
One is the “Club Activities Stage”.
That's where the brass bands, choruses, film clubs and such from each school will be performing and presenting.

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line: We'll mostly be running support for them, by preparing anything they need and organizing places to practice.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line:
Then, we have the other one...
The “Planning Committee Performance Stage”.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The “Planning Committee Performance Stage”...?

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line: The members of the planning committee are being asked to come up with their own performance and be a part of it.

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line: In simple terms, it's meant to be something we can create on our own, without having to be a part of any clubs and such.

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line: Again, we'll mostly be supporting the clubs with their performances. But for this, we're being asked to plan and run everything ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that could be interesting...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I didn't realize we'd be doing so much.)

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line: Anyway, I'd like to immediately get down to nuts and bolts, but...

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line: We're still in talks with the advisors for the clubs at each school, so we don't know which are going to be participating yet.

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line: So today, I'd like for us to start discussing what we'll be doing for our own performance.

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line: Any ideas?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Umm... Are we allowed to do whatever we like for this?

rows.Speaker: Stage Leader
rows.Line: Yes, but we won't be able to do anything that involves special equipment or skills, since we want as many people as possible to participate.

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line:
Right.
Which means musical instruments are out. No bands or orchestras.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, good point...
That would exclude a lot of people.

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line: Then, what about a chorus?

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line: Hmm... What if one of the schools sends over a chorus? We might want to avoid doing the same thing as someone else.

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line: Yeah, true! This is harder than I thought.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Something that lots of people can participate in while also being fun, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But everyone's good at different things...
What kind of performance would allow us to work as one and make use of our talents?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait...!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: S-Sorry, but I have an idea!
bgm_area00004
The next day
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I see!
Which is when you arrived on doing a musical!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's true, musicals involve more than simply acting. There's singing, dancing, art... Quite a lot goes into them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Exactly. The theatre clubs apparently do regular plays for the most part, so we shouldn't overlap with their stage performances either.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Getting to put on a show with people from the other schools sounds like a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And you were chosen to lead the production of your guys' musical, right, Nene?! That's so cool☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah...
Everyone sorta said that they wanted someone who knew how to handle things, and that just happened to be me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, the fact is that you were chosen to be the leader!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Let us know if there's anything we can do to help!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, be sure to ask us as well!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks. But aren't you guys gonna be busy, Tsukasa? You have to prepare for your own performances.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, Tsukasa and Emu will be performing as actors, while I'll be working as a director. But I'm sure we'll be able to lend a hand with whatever you might need.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, don't be afraid to ask us to do stuff behind the scenes in addition to our jobs as actors!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I really appreciate it. I wasn't sure if I'd be able to successfully juggle writing a script and recruiting people, all while practicing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, Nene, you're gonna write the script?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I learned a lot when I wrote the screenplay for the film we made for the arts festival, so I wanted to try doing it again.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, actually... We know roughly what we're going to do as the planning committee, but we still haven't figured out any specifics. Mind helping me brainstorm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not at all!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We gotta make it a excitingly wonderhoy story☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Can you tell us what the plan is so far?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So far... We want to include a variety of songs from a mix of genres in order to let a lot of people participate.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds wonderful.
You'll get to swim in a sea of different songs, all on one stage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... In that case, why not have musicians specializing in different genres appear?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, that should make it easier to include the different songs you want, and let you adjust the script to suit your actors too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, then...
What if the protagonist learned to love music by becoming friends with those musicians?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, that could be good...!
Then...
